subject: added general print statements plus doc

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: added general print statements plus doc
parts:
I added print statements to Stan's models.
They're now of the form

print("1+1=", 1+1);

allowing strings like "1+1=" and expressions
like (1+1) to be interleaved. Platform-specific
newlines automatically added.

From the RStan side, everything should still work
as is, with the print statements just being ignored
(the ostream pointers are given 0 default args and
they're always the last argument). Plumbing through
the R stream for standard output should follow
the same path as for the errors (Jiqiang -- let me
know if you need more help -- I realize this paragraph's
a bit sketchy).

I added sections to the user's guide and
reference manual. (I also added sections on
comments.)

- Bob
